extracted.name: Easy Asian Dipping Sauce
extracted.description: This Asian dipping sauce made with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and rice vinegar is delicious served with dumplings and egg rolls.
instruction_lines: Whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, honey, ginger, sesame seeds, and sesame oil in a bowl.
